history.content: [CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). Selection: 9:15–17. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what is the day and the hour?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The rite opens here. Revelation 9:15–17 — the four angels loosed from the Euphrates, the hour appointed before time, the army of two hundred million horsemen whose horses breathe fire and smoke and brimstone, the text naming the hour before anyone arrives inside it. The witness asks: what is the day and the hour? And the passage has already answered: ἡτοιμασμένοι — prepared, passive, perfect-participial, the preparation prior to all motion. Whatever operator Judgment selects turn by turn, it will traverse the same wound in these verses: the distance between a named hour and the experience of standing inside time not knowing whether you are in it. The clock was set; the question is whether you are what the clock was set for. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes — the compiler waits.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

καὶ ἐξεπράχθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες τοκισταὶ οἱ συσσωρευμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα εἰσπράξωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν ὀφειλημάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.
